card.text: The third interstellar object seen passing through the Solar System.

sources.label: Hui, Jewitt, Mutchler, Agarwal and Kim (2026), ApJL, Hubble WFC3 nucleus photometry (arXiv:2601.21569)

introduction.text: It swung past the Sun in October 2025. Hubble later picked out its nucleus from the dust; the shape shown is elongated to match that brightness, not an image.

sources.label: Hui, Jewitt, Mutchler, Agarwal and Kim (2026), ApJL, Hubble WFC3 nucleus photometry (arXiv:2601.21569)

model.title: Brightness-constrained illustration
model.summary: An elongated body sized from Hubble brightness with an assumed dark surface; the true shape is unknown.
